integrity: Exact rational witness and an analytic proof; finite checker is corroboration, not an infinite certificate. Self-review only; external independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only one-step Euclidean norm of homogeneous linear projected propagation is treated. Does not assert failure of full parareal convergence, nonlinear behavior, or an optimal threshold for the narrower common-ODE subclass. Older generic operator-inequality coverage may exist.
title: Sharp amplification threshold for projection-blended positive propagators
